title: Rollbar Item
description: A Rollbar item representing a unique error or message tracked by Rollbar, grouped by fingerprint. Items are the primary unit of work in Rollbar's error tracking workflow.

id.description: The internal item ID used for API operations.

counter.description: The project-specific counter displayed in Rollbar URLs (e.g., items/456).

environment.description: The environment where this item was first seen (e.g., production, staging).

framework.description: Framework identifier code representing the application framework.

hash.description: The fingerprint hash used to group occurrences into this item.

title.description: The title or summary of the item, typically derived from the error message.

first_occurrence_id.description: The instance ID of the first occurrence of this item.

first_occurrence_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when this item was first seen.

last_occurrence_id.description: The instance ID of the most recent occurrence of this item.

last_occurrence_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp of the most recent occurrence.

level.description: The severity level of the item.

status.description: The current workflow status of the item.

total_occurrences.description: Total number of times this item has occurred.

unique_occurrences.description: Number of unique occurrences based on deduplication criteria.

project_id.description: The project ID this item belongs to.

resolved_in_version.description: The code version in which this item was resolved.

assigned_user_id.description: The user ID of the person assigned to investigate this item.

integrations_data.description: Data from third-party integrations linked to this item.

last_activated_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when the item was last activated or reactivated.

last_resolved_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp when the item was last resolved.

ItemLevel.description: The severity level for Rollbar items.

ItemStatus.description: The workflow status for Rollbar items.
